WITH film_lengths AS (
  SELECT rating, AVG(length) AS rating_avg_length
  FROM film
  WHERE length IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY rating
),
overall_avg_value AS (
  SELECT AVG(length) AS overall_avg
  FROM film
  WHERE length IS NOT NULL
),
first_cut AS (
  SELECT fl.rating, fl.rating_avg_length
  FROM film_lengths fl
  WHERE fl.rating_avg_length > (SELECT overall_avg FROM overall_avg_value)
),
first_cut_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(rating_avg_length) AS first_cut_avg
  FROM first_cut
),
second_cut AS (
  SELECT fc.rating, fc.rating_avg_length
  FROM first_cut fc
  WHERE fc.rating_avg_length > (SELECT first_cut_avg FROM first_cut_mean)
)
SELECT
  AVG(sc.rating_avg_length) AS mean_final,
  AVG(sc.rating_avg_length) - (SELECT overall_avg FROM overall_avg_value) AS avg_above_overall,
  AVG(sc.rating_avg_length) - (SELECT first_cut_avg FROM first_cut_mean) AS avg_above_first_cut
FROM second_cut sc;
